short_scenes.caption: Eyes in the dark.
short_scenes.narration: Yellow eyes glowed in the dark. One wolf. Then three. Then seven.

short_scenes.caption: "The ember, Mia!"
short_scenes.narration: The ember! John shouted. Mia blew on it with shaking breath, and a tiny flame came back to life.

short_scenes.caption: Fire versus fear.
short_scenes.narration: John grabbed a burning stick and swung it at the pack. The wolves yelped and scattered into the night.

short_scenes.caption: "John… I have to tell you something."
short_scenes.narration: Breathless, Mia held his arm. John, she whispered. I have to tell you something.
